content: Yeesu na Nikodem
Raakeen ƴaar teeku Nikodem, a ɓaahee ŋ Farisen ca te a nikee kilifa Yawuut.
A hayya ŋ Yeesu na wek a woosa ɗe ne : « Jangɗohohi, ɓoo inhiɗ ne a Kooh woos ɗa ne fu jangiɗ ɓoo ; laam ali ɓo' minɗi haɓiɗ firndeeci fu na haɓɗe ne Kooh hunɗi na ɗe ɗah. »
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne : « Ñam na woyee ɗa wa, te amba ne wa keeh : Ɓo' nu rimkisɗi ɗah, a minɗi ɓaah ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh. »
Nikodem meekissa ɗe ne : « Ɓoyi kaɗ po yaɓko'iɗ, a min na rimkohis ? A miniɗ aasis ŋ rookiŋ yaayiŋ ɗe, a rimkis e ? »
Yeesu loffa ne : « Ñam na woyee ɗa wa te amba ne wa keeh, ɓo' nu rimukɗi rimki puloh ŋ masuɓ na Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh ɗah, a minanɗi aas ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.
In nu rimkoh ŋ ɓo' ɗah, wa ɓay kipes ɓo', in nu rimkoh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗah, wa ɓay kipes kiŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Kina feyu ŋ ini ŋ woo ɗa ne : “ Ɗu joyiɗ rimkis. ”
Puuɗsi na laɓe ŋ ɗisik nu wa waaɗ ɗah. Fu kerhee wa waaye fu inhuu ɗiski wa puloh na ɗiski wa na kee. Wa mand ɗaa ŋ ɓo' nu rimkoh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗah. »
Nikodem meeksissa ɗe ne : « Ineem min na nikoh ? »
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne : « Jangɗohoh hend na ɗa ŋ ɗooƴ Israayel po fu inahɗi ineem e ?
Ñam woo ɗa wa te amba ne wa keeh, ɓoo na woye ini ɓoo inah, ɓoo seede'ee ini ɓoo hot, te ɗu na teyɗukeeɗi seedeeniŋ ɓoo.
Ŋ woyee ɗu in ciŋ kehƴi, ɗu kosɗi so ɗah, ɗu kosohan ndo na, ne ŋ woo ɗu in caŋ ɗafka ɗah ?
Ali ɓo' rapɗi ŋ ɗafka, ɗal Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi, yi ruhsoh nga.
Te findi Musaa meeɓohee iiña moosa ŋ kehƴa hulanga ne ɓooɓa hot ɗe, Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi joyiɗ meeɓohu ɗaa,
ne ɓo' nu kos ɗe ɗah, raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe. »
Kooh waaɗiɗ adinaani po a eɗohha Kuɓkiŋ ɗe yino-kongi ne ɓo' nu kos Kuɓki ɗah, fu sooƴuu, waaye fu raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Laam Kooh woosɗi Kuɓkiŋ ɗe ŋ Adina ne a atte ɓi Adina, waaye ne Adina min mucɗu taamboh nga ɗe.
Yaa nu kos ɗe ɗah, atte'sanɗi. Waaye yaa nu kosɗi ɗe ɗah, a atte'uuɗ po ƴutiɗ ŋ kosaaɗiiki a kosaaɗi Kuɓkiŋ Kooh yino-kongi.
Atteeni weɗɗi : Siñaari hayiɗ Adina, waaye ɓooɓi, a ñuusi ngisohiɗ ɓa siñaari sagu ne tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa moɗɗi.
Tumoh moɗaaɗiici jen, sangiɗ siñaari, te ɓa hayanɗi nga, ɓa neƴƴoh ne in ci ɓa na tume hotu noh cong.
Waaye ɓi na pese ŋ keeh ki na haye ŋ siñaari, ne ɓooɓi min hot ne ini ɓa na haɓɗe, kurkoh ŋ Kooh.
Yeesu na Yahya Ɓoktohi
Wa in ceem coot, Yeesu kaɗta kur caŋ Yudee na taalubeeciŋ ɗe ; a nikka na ɓa nga neeh caam, a ɓoktoheeɗa.
Yahya nameeɗa ɓoktoh ŋ Enon ŋ sero Salim, ndaam nikee ɗisik laayiɗ masuɓ ; ɓooɓa kaɗeeɗa ne ɓa ɓoktuk.
Waam raak Yahya taƴuuɗi ŋ kaso paaɗ.
Wa raakka mbeh taalubeeciŋ ɗe taastiɗoheeɗa na ƴaar ŋ Yawuut ca ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ findi ɓa na farsukohe.
Ɓa hayya ŋ Yahya ɓa woosa ɗe ne : « Jangɗohohi, ƴaari nikee na ɗa ŋ ɓaka faahaŋ Yurdan, te fu seedeesa ɗe, ɗiski wa nik, a yaa ɓoktoheeɗa te ɓooɓi jen ɓaa kaɗ nga ɗe de'. »
Yahya loffa ɓa ne : « Ɓo' minɗi raak ali in ne Kooh eɗɗi ɗe wa ɗah.
Ɗu, ɗu miniɗ to seede ne ŋ woyiɗ ne : Ñam Mucɗohi Gapohse haa, waaye ŋ woosu ne ŋ adug ɗe.
Kilooki, wuu heɗ kilooki ; waaye nawle heɗ kilooki, yi nik ŋ sero heɗ kilooki te a sikɗukee ɗe, na sume sum lool ne a kerah hoosooriŋ ɗe ɗah. Sumeem weɗ sumi ŋ sum woti te ɗiski wa nik, wa mitiɗ.
A yi, a joy joy ɓaat yak a kaɗe, mi, ŋ uupee ƴissuut. »
Yi puloh ɗafki
Yi puloh ɗafki, a yi uup ɗafuk ɓooɓi jen ; yi puloh kehƴi a wuu kehƴi, te a na woye in ciŋ kehƴi. Ee di', Yi puloh Asamaan, [a yi uup ɗafuk ɓooɓi jen.]
A na woye ini a hot te a kerahhaa waaye ɓooɓi teyɗukɗi seedeeniŋ ɗe.
Yi teyɗuk seedeeniŋ ɗe teeɓohiɗ ne a huniɗ ne in nu Kooh woo ɗah, wa keeh.
Yi Kooh woos, a na onee ɗe on Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani te Fuuɗsi a on ɗe na topeeɗi, tahha po in ci a na woye, ca woo ciŋ Kooh.
Baabi waaɗiɗ Kuɓki te a degiɗ jen ŋ yaah ce.
Yi kos Kuɓki, a raakiɗ kipes ki heyɗi reehe. Yi sang kerhiɗ Kuɓki, a raakanɗi kipes ki keeh-keehi te ayrukiŋ Kooh genan na ɗe.
